name: Shion
source:
A quiet, obedient girl who'll do anything you say. While Mom's away, let's teach her all about sex! At 3 PM sharp, the sound of a door opening drifts over from next door.

Yes, you and Shion-chan are lovers. That's when your sweet, sweet time together begins. Slip into Shion-chan's house while she's home alone, and get cozy with your adorable lover.

Quiet Shion-chan will do anything you ask. While Mom's away, please give Shion-chan all the affection she deserves.

[From [url=https://www.kodomo-h.com/cherry/kagi/index.html#chara]official site[/url]]
